2438-6553-8207.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

907-5256-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

4871-5147-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

1169-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1169-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1169-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2440-2703-7297.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-3698-6972.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Scrapyard Recombiner enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4241-4552-6774.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1829-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1829-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

45-512-4241.description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Khalni Gem to become a creature.
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Khalni Gem, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

480-5231-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3188-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3188-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

874-1170-1329-1537.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-1537.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Zealous Conscripts.
When Zealous Conscripts enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-4094-5220-5631-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4094-5220-5631-6961.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

1921-2059-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Village Bell-Ringer token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Village Bell-Ringer token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

851-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
851-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
851-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 3.

4002-4067-6072-6281.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4067-6072-6281.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Graveshifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Graveshifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Graveshifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

813-2072-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Scrollshift.
813-2072-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1020-1117-3836-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2653-2972-6455-6517.description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}{G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters, it first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa and Dragonback Assault trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve a Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax and Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Encroaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat

880-2653-5702.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

751-2060-5684.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
751-2060-5684.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Metastatic Evangel trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1514-4613-4679-4929-6076.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
1514-4613-4679-4929-6076.description:
Cast Chicken Troupe by paying {1}{G}.
When Chicken Troupe enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {TK} and putting a name sticker on Well Rested.
Activate Yenna targeting the Well Rested with a name sticker by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of it named Well Rested attached to any creature, untapping Yenna, and scrying 2.
Each copy of Well Rested attached to Yenna triggers, each one putting two +1/+1 counters on Yenna and causing you to gain 2 life and draw a card.
Activate Yenna using Cryptic Trilobite's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Dimir Aqueduct.
Repeat.
74-943-3478.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Dimir Aqueduct instead.

224-730-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-730-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

2292-2527-3143-3464.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-2527-3143-3464.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1117-3689-4659-5346.notablePrerequisites: One of the artifact creatures must be on the battlefield, with the other in your graveyard.
1117-3689-4659-5346.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact creature dies, it and Crime Novelist trigger.
Resolve the artifact creature's trigger, returning the other artifact creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2226-2397-4518.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2226-2397-4518.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-4518.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's other abilities.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1869-3542-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Conspiracy.
1869-3542-4875.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Palinchron with haste.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3305-4050-4812-5237.notablePrerequisites: Animate Dead attached to Body Launderer.
3305-4050-4812-5237.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier, adding {C}{C}.
Renegade Rallier dies, triggering Body Launderer's first ability, causing it to connive.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {C}{C}.
Body Launderer dies, triggering its second ability, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat.

2082-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Sadistic Glee attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
2082-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

776-1329-4534-5025.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4534-5025.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Spellbook to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Spellbook.
Cast Spellbook.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2438-2753-4191-5220.description:
Cast Elvish Visionary by paying {0}.
Elvish Visionary enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Elvish Visionary.
Elvish Visionary dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Elvish Visionary on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Elvish Visionary trigger from step 2, causing you to draw Elvish Visionary from the top of your library.
Repeat.
